# pick_two_obj_and_place

## Goal
- Your task is to put exactly two instances of a specific object (e.g., book, soapbottle, handtowel) into a specified target receptacle (e.g., bed, garbagecan, countertop).
- You must collect and move both items. Do not stop after placing only one.

## Search Strategy
### Systematic search of all receptacles
- Start by reading the room description: list every furniture item (table, shelf, drawer, cabinet, holder, etc.) that could contain the object.
- First check open surfaces (shelf, desk, countertop, coffeetable, handtowelholder, etc.) — objects there are visible immediately.
- For closed containers (drawer, cabinet, dresser), go to each one and open it to see its contents. Do not skip any.
- Move on to the next receptacle if the object is not found; do not repeatedly check the same place.
- If you still haven't found two objects after checking everything, re-examine the room description and try receptacles you might have overlooked (e.g., ottoman, sidetable, fridge).

## Placement Process
### Collect and place the first object
- When you see an object of the required type, take it: `take <object> from <source>`.
- If the source is closed, open it first.
- Then go to the target receptacle (`go to <target>`).
- Move the object to the target (`move <object> to <target>`).

### Collect and place the second object (iteration)
- After placing the first object, continue searching for the second instance using the same systematic search.
- Repeat the take → go → move sequence for the second object.

### Ensure placement before moving on (critical)
- After taking an object, immediately go to the target and move it. Do not examine other containers or get distracted.
- If you ever pick up an object, your next action must be moving it to the target.

## Completion Detection
- After moving the second object, the environment will indicate task success. If unsure, you can check your last observation.
- If you have moved both objects but the task is not marked complete, search again — you may have missed one (e.g., two different instances of the same object type).
changelog: First version created from scratch, covering goal definition, systematic search strategy, two-step placement with iteration, and completion detection.

round_failures.root_cause: Agent never found any laptop; it only searched drawers and a coffee table, missing other locations.
round_failures.skill_tree_gap: No systematic search for multiple objects.

round_failures.root_cause: Agent placed only one candle and then stopped without searching for a second candle.
round_failures.skill_tree_gap: Missing loop or check for completion of multiple objects.

round_failures.root_cause: Agent took one toiletpaper and went to drawer but did not place it, and did not search for a second.
Agent never found any bread; it only searched cabinets and saw dishsponge, no bread.
Agent never found any cup; it searched cabinets and drawers but saw only peppershakers and soapbottles.
Agent never found any book; it examined shelves and drawer, but saw only mugs and other items, no book.
